body: The Star authors card sits alone at the top of the page and everything below it is empty — on a 900px viewport two thirds of the screen is blank. Either centre the card vertically or give the page something else to hold.
the starred author chips wrap into three rows that don't line up
Add is enabled before anything is typed in the author search, so clicking it does nothing and gives no reason. Disable it until the field has a value.
the little × for removing a starred author is about 8px and sits right against the handle — I keep missing it. Make the hit area the full chip height.
this page feels empty

In a tag row the description and the keywords line are the same size, weight and colour, so they read as one paragraph and the word "keywords:" does all the separating. Set the keywords line in the muted foreground, or in the mono face the rest of the app uses.
The Description field in the New tag form is showing its example text in full black, so I thought the form was already filled in. It is a placeholder — grey it out.
Could we drop one of the two counts in the tags header? "Your tags (139)" and "Static 10 / Dynamic 129" say the same thing twice.

Delete sits right next to Edit on every tag row with nothing between them, and delete is the red one. One slip and a tag with five hundred likes on it is gone. Move it behind an overflow menu, or ask first.
the STATIC badge is so small and grey I didn't see it until I went looking for it
why is the tag colour a hex field rather than a swatch picker?
The helper text under Keywords and under Author handles is grey on white at what looks like 11px. I can only read it by leaning in.
love that the new tag form explains what the description is actually for
Likes is the only stat tile with no second line under its number, so the row of five is ragged along the bottom. Give it one, or drop the others.
The Tagging coverage card is a heading, a percentage, one bar, and then three hundred pixels of nothing before the card ends. Beside Top tags, which is full, it reads as broken.
webdev, unknown-resource and celebrity are three different bars in Top tags and all three are the same red-orange. I can't tell them apart without reading the labels.
Tags over time is cut off by the fold — all you get is a heading, a dropdown and the top of one orange bar.
can the Last year dropdown remember what I picked?
the numbers on the right of each bar are doing a lot of work here, nice
something's off about the spacing on this one
The avatar in the header is a broken image on every page — you get the little torn-page icon where the photo should be.
The search field and the contains dropdown are fused into one pill with no divider, so the dropdown reads as part of the placeholder until you click it.
Show more is set in the same weight and colour as the tweet body, so it doesn't read as something you can click. Make it the accent colour.
the two columns end at different heights and it looks untidy
Only some cards have the footer bar with the tag chip and the timestamp — the ones with no tag just stop. The border above it appears and disappears down the column.
Is "awaiting tags" the same thing as "untagged"? The header says nought awaiting tags and the Untagged filter beside it has plenty in it.
The Likes header prints 8165 with no separator while every number on Insights is formatted as 8,165. Pick one.
Can we get the like and repost counts onto tabular figures? They jiggle as you scroll past cards whose numbers have different digit counts.
broken, see screenshot
I'd change the wording on the Actions button — Actions tells me nothing about what is in the menu. Bulk actions, or Manage, would.
